title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Mascara
overview: After his wife's passing, an old man spends one last night in their home—before bidding an unforgettable farewell. Written & directed by Ahmed Said Ağaoğlu. In development.

title: ÒPI
overview: Eighteen-year-old Trina plans to escape her toxic mother, but her plans are upended by the sudden arrival of mysterious relatives from Kashubia. Their visit unearths long-buried family secrets and forces her to confront a dark legacy, revealing unsettling rituals rooted in ancient Kashubian beliefs.

title: Ātaahua
overview: A lonely man seeks solace in an art gallery, but instead meets the face of death- Hinenui Te Pō

title: Toulouse MacDonnell Upcoming project
overview: The story of two detectives in Soho.

title: Nasty
overview: After an injury sidelines Dylan’s ability to train for the Olympics, the determined gymnast must regain the trust of her demanding coach while facing off against a prodigious new competitor threatening to eclipse her place in the spotlight.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet - surviving fatherhood - while saving the world.

title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Citric Acid
overview: A young artist is stalked via the internet by a mysterious online celebrity who harshly criticizes their artwork.

title: Wild Wild East
overview: In occupied Poland 1943, German official Martin Wolff is sent to a remote village to investigate the disappearance of a Jewish lawyer. His arrival unsettles the fragile order between scarred villagers, corrupt collaborators, and Nazi authorities, unearthing a web of betrayal and greed tied to whispers of the lawyer’s hidden fortune. Yet as the village’s darkest truths come to light, Wolff’s search may be hiding more than it reveals.

title: Ink
overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

title: La Gradiva
overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

title: The Beekeeper 2
overview: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

title: The Mirror's Echo
overview: A grieving teen discovers that her deceased twin sister is communicating through her vanity mirror, but the entity reflecting back is far from a sibling.

title: The Alone Boy
overview: The Alone Boy is an upcoming drama-action film directed by Resad Ajim, developed as an emotionally driven cinematic project exploring themes of loneliness, ambition, survival, and personal transformation.  The movie is expected to combine emotional storytelling with intense character development, focusing on the struggles of a young individual navigating isolation and conflict in a changing world.  The film centers around a boy whose life is shaped by emotional hardship, betrayal, and the pressure of survival. As the story progresses, the central character faces challenges involving friendship, trust, family struggles, and the pursuit of identity. The narrative is designed to portray the emotional journey of a person attempting to rise above difficult circumstances while confronting inner fears and external obstacles.

title: Dante
overview: Responding to an emergency call, a young paramedic unwittingly finds himself thrust into the middle of a war between two crime lords, triggering an escalating series of gruesome twists and turns over the course of one crazy night.

title: Ultrakill
overview: Two adolescent boys get bullied everyday and record everything. While recording not only do they show themselves being bullied but they also chronicle everythint before they go on a killing spree on their town

title: Night of The Abandoned City
overview: A spin-off from the Abandoned city movie focusing on the mysterious man and his son in the night of the Abandoned city

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Fjord
overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: The Rescue
overview: A former rodeo cowboy takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.

title: Elsinore
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

title: Ages of Madness: The Howling of the Jinn
overview: A cosmic horror animated movie.
